input.title: You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (13 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/You_Seem_Pretty_Sad_for_a_Girl_So_in_Love, https://www.discogs.com/release/37593093-Olivia-Rodrigo-You-Seem-Pretty-Sad-For-A-Girl-So-In-Love. Third studio album, released June 12, 2026 via Geffen. 13 tracks. 'What's Wrong with Me' features Robert Smith of The Cure (first guest appearance on her studio album). 'Expectations' had a remix featuring Chappell Roan released as the fourth single; album version is Olivia solo.
